# Aaron Neiderhiser on The Joe Reis Show


In this episode, Aaron discusses the path to making healthcare analytics more open, transparent, and practical for real-world teams.


Aaron Neiderhiser joined *The Joe Reis Show* to discuss why healthcare analytics remains difficult and why Tuva is building open infrastructure for healthcare data teams.


The conversation covers fragmented healthcare data, transparent transformation logic, and the data foundation teams need before analytics and AI applications can be trusted.


[Listen to Episode](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/aaron-neiderhiser-creating-the-future-of/id1676305617?i=1000715421706)
